name: Belle
text: A curious book lover who sees beauty beyond appearances.
story: Belle shows that true beauty is found in kindness, curiosity, and a brave heart.

name: Moana
text: A fearless voyager who follows the call of the sea.
story: Moana sails across the ocean to save her people and discovers who she truly is.

name: Ariel
text: An adventurous mermaid who dreams of a world above the waves.
story: Ariel follows her curiosity and teaches us to chase our dreams, even when they seem far away.
